Definition: a Benjaminite, or descendent of Benjamin
BiblicalUsage: The word Benjaminite means a son of the right hand, and it shows up 9 times, including Judges 3:15.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Benjaminite is worth knowing, because every word God chose carries weight.
